name: @sundial/dsh-tools-gnomon
description: Cordis plugin: registers Gnomon's read tools (TOOL_REGISTRY + gnomon_show_view) and gnomon_assert in dsh's tool registry over the gnomonKernel/gnomonDb/gnomonMemory services, sets Gnomon's persona as the agent system prompt, and guards the agent's LLM calls with the 'ask' daily budget.
